requirement.label: Operating experience on any waters
requirement.text: Twelve months of experience in the operation of vessels.

requirement.label: Of which on ocean or near-coastal waters
requirement.text: At least 3 of the 12 months on ocean or near-coastal waters. Inside Passage service counts as near coastal, and Great Lakes service counts day for day.

notes: Eight hours of watchstanding or day-working is one day. Overtime adds nothing.
Twelve hours or more is one day. The 1½-day credit on two-watch vessels is at the Coast Guard's discretion and is never added here.
⚠️ Unverified: 46 CFR does not say how to date service that crosses midnight. A trip is credited to the day it began, and one entry is never more than one day.

notChecked.why: Which roles aboard count toward this license is open decision D4. Every role is shown, none is filtered.

notChecked.label: The license's tonnage limit
notChecked.why: The tonnage a license is limited to depends on the vessels served on; that is open decision D5.

notChecked.label: Inland service toward the ocean or near-coastal part
notChecked.why: Inland service (other than the Great Lakes) may count toward a near-coastal endorsement only up to half. That limit is not applied yet, so inland days count toward the total only.
